**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Field-level view of soybean canopy, predominantly healthy green
- In the upper-center area, several plants appear distinctly pale/whitish-yellow — bleached stems visible above the canopy
- These bleached plants stand out prominently against the green background

**Key observations:**
- The bleached white/pale appearance of stems rising above an otherwise green canopy is the classic field signature of White Mold (Sclerotinia stem rot)
- White Mold description: "dry dead stems develop a bleached white appearance" and "dead leaves remain attached to stems while turning brown"
- The reference image confirms bleached white stems with sclerotia as diagnostic features

The test image matches the field-level presentation of White Mold — scattered pale/bleached plants within a green canopy.
